title: HelperSSHPasswordPromptParams
description: The helper asking the coordinator's OWN connection-password ask for the one live person who is this connection's credential, over the interactive rung's bare `password` method (nocx-y6fh7 item 4, round 3). It is a DIFFERENT reverse op from `prompt`: a password ask correlates to the connection it belongs to (connection, profileId, both echoed unchanged from the destination the coordinator itself resolved), so the coordinator answers through the SAME requester a direct dial's own prompt rung uses — the "Password for {profile}" dialog with its remember checkbox (ADR-0017) — rather than a second, profile-blind box. `prompt` stays the server's own keyboard-interactive questions, which carry no profile and no remember concept.

connection.description: The saved profile's display name, echoed from the destination's connectionName. Empty for a destination with no saved profile.

profileId.description: The saved profile's id, echoed from the destination's profileId. Empty for a destination with no saved profile — the ask then falls back to the bare wire requester, which has no profile to bind a remember to.

host.description: The host the question is about, as the RESOLVED value the destination carried.

port.description: The resolved port, for the same reason and by the same rule.

user.description: The resolved account the question names.
